create_runner_subclass: create a subclass of Runner that implements run, save_state, and load_state methods
use_mockrunner_for_testing: use MockRunner to test run, save_state, and load_state with configurable x, y, z values
implement_preemptablemixin: implement PreemptableMixin in a Runner subclass to add STOPFAIR preemption and atomic checkpointing
handle_stopfair_preemption: handle STOPFAIR sentinel file detection by calling check_stopfair and handle_stopfair on a PreemptableMixin runner
save_atomic_checkpoint: save an atomic checkpoint with resume_config and portable_config using PreemptableMixin save_state method
